_meta: Project 8 WA answers. b = Milestone 1 Baseline (pre-remediation, from before-evidence); p = Milestone 2 Post-remediation (omitted = unchanged). Scope: P1 live + P2-P7 as-built. Finding IDs reference findings/findings-register.md.

cloud-financial-management.n: Monthly budget with ACTUAL 80/100% + FORECASTED 100% alerts (F-62). Zero-spend hard rule; every README has a Cost Analysis. October bill USD 0.00 (F-61). Budget threshold ($5) loose for a zero-spend account; zero-spend budget recommended (F-63).

govern-usage.n: Policy: zero AWS spend, skip paid services and record them as cost decisions. Control: budget alerts. Single account, no account structure. Project lifecycle tracking failed for P4 (F-36): left running 8 weeks.

monitor-usage.n: AWS Budgets + Billing console. Cost Explorer API intentionally avoided ($0.01/request). No tagging/cost allocation categories.

decomissioning-resources.n: Baseline: teardown-after-demo process, but P4 (21 resources) never destroyed (F-36), SAM bootstrap stack + versioned bucket left (F-37/F-52), Lambda log groups unmanaged (F-40). Resource Explorer index found stale (F-53). Post: leftovers removed and verified; reusable direct-API sweep script (scripts/sweep.sh) tracks resources across us-east-1/us-west-2.

select-service.n: Documented cost trade-offs per component: NAT instance vs NAT Gateway (~$32/mo), Nginx vs ALB (~$16/mo), k3s vs EKS (~$73/mo control plane), Single-AZ RDS, GitHub Actions vs CodePipeline.

type-size-number-resources.n: Free-tier sizing modelled per project. P5 right-sized from data after a memory-exhaustion incident (Traefik/ServiceLB/metrics-server disabled, swap). x86_64 Lambdas; arm64 not used (F-50).

pricing-model.n: us-east-1 primary (lowest pricing); CloudFront PriceClass_100. Free tier only; no Savings Plans/RIs (not applicable at zero spend).

data-transfer.n: Baseline: CloudFront fronted P1 but the public bucket allowed direct S3 reads billed as S3 transfer (F-54). Post: OAC makes CloudFront the only path (cache + free tier).

manage-demand-resources.n: P4 SQS buffers ingest from processing; Lambda supplies capacity on demand. API stage throttling not set (F-43).

evaluate-new-services.n: This Project 8 Well-Architected review; no recurring review cadence defined yet.

evaluate-cost-effort.n: Terraform for all projects (P4 SAM retired), GitHub Actions for P3.

priorities.n: Governance: zero-spend rule. Threat landscape: P6 account security audit. Trade-offs recorded in each project's Design Decisions Q&A.

ops-model.n: Single-owner learning account; all resources owned by one engineer. No tagging for ownership.

org-culture.n: Portfolio exists to experiment and learn; each project ends with What I Learned.

observability.n: No KPIs, alarms, tracing or API access logs (F-39, F-47). Lambda logs only, never-expire retention (F-40).

dev-integ.n: Git + Terraform everywhere; P3 GitHub Actions test/build/health-check; README and diagram conventions shared across projects. Single environment only. P3 tested artifact is not the deployed artifact (F-30). AL2 past end of support in P2 (F-16).

mit-deploy-risks.n: terraform plan reviewed before apply; P3 container health test before deploy. No rollback path or safe deployment strategy (F-31).

ready-to-support.n: Deployment and teardown steps documented per README; plan-based apply decisions (P1 remediation guarded by exact plan match).

workload-observability.n: No alerts, dashboards or log analysis (F-39, F-47).

event-response.n: No event/incident process; budget alerts are the only notification.

evolve-ops.n: P5 memory-exhaustion incident analysed and fixed; lessons documented per project; this review drives improvement.

performing-architecture.n: Service choices compared and documented per project; Well-Architected used as guidance; cost is a primary input.

compute-hardware.n: Lambda for event-driven P4, EC2/k3s elsewhere. P5 tuned to fit 1 GB RAM. No metrics-driven sizing; x86_64 only (F-50).

data-management.n: S3 (static), DynamoDB on-demand (P4), RDS PostgreSQL (P2). /stats uses DynamoDB Scan (F-48).

networking.n: CloudFront edge caching with compression. P7 measured healthy ~0.57s vs failover ~1.03s. Post: HTTP/3 enabled (F-58), alt-svc h3 verified.

process-culture.n: No performance KPIs, monitoring or load testing; P2 OS past end of support (F-16).

manage-service-limits.n: Free-tier limits and t3.micro memory constraints designed around (P5).

planning-network-topology.n: CloudFront public endpoint (P1/P7). P2 VPC /16 with /24 tiers leaves room, but all tiers in one AZ (F-17).

service-architecture.n: P4 split into ingest/process/query functions; P5 two microservices with service discovery.

prevent-interaction-failure.n: P4 decouples ingest and processing with SQS. Idempotency not ensured; visibility timeout = function timeout risks duplicate processing (F-44).

mitigate-interaction-failure.n: maxReceiveCount 3 then DLQ; Lambda timeouts set; stateless functions/containers. No throttling (F-43); no partial batch failure handling (F-45).

monitor-aws-resources.n: No CloudWatch alarms incl. DLQ depth (F-39); no tracing (F-47).

adapt-to-changes.n: Lambda/SQS scale automatically. EC2 tiers fixed size, no ASG (F-17). No load testing.

tracking-change-management.n: Terraform and GitHub Actions deployments; documented runbooks; pytest + container health test in P3.

backing-up-data.n: All content and infrastructure reproducible from Git/IaC. P1 bucket versioning off (F-57); DynamoDB PITR off as cost decision (F-49).

fault-isolation.n: P7 multi-Region (us-east-1 -> us-west-2) for static content. P2/P5 single AZ, single instance (F-17, F-06).

withstand-component-failures.n: P7 CloudFront origin-group failover tested. NAT instance SPOF (F-18); no health alarms.

testing-resiliency.n: P5 incident analysed; P7 simulated primary outage. No game days or chaos engineering.

planning-for-recovery.n: P7 pilot-light style replication + failover, tested. RPO from one 26s sample (F-08); one-way replication, manual failback (F-09). Recovery objectives not formally defined.

securely-operate.n: Root has MFA and no access keys. P6 audit defined control objectives. Single account. Root used for console on 2026-10-20 (F-28). P6 teardown regressed the account baseline (F-01, F-03, F-35).

identities.n: MFA on root and admin. Admin IAM user has a long-lived access key (F-02). P2 DB credentials hardcoded (F-13). No GitHub secrets stored (verified). Post: credential report reviewed; password policy 14 chars/24 reuse (F-03 fixed).

permissions.n: P4 IAM scoped to specific queue/table ARNs, but one role shared by all functions (F-38). P6 guardrails torn down. Post: IAM Access Analyzer (external access) active, zero findings (F-35 fixed).

detect-investigate-events.n: CloudTrail Event History (free, 90 days) verified recording management events; no trail by cost decision (F-01). Lambda logs. No GuardDuty/Security Hub (cost decisions).

network-protection.n: P2 public/private/isolated tiers with SG chaining. SSH open to 0.0.0.0/0 (F-12); P3 SSH deploy needs port 22 open (F-29). No WAF (cost).

protect-compute.n: No vulnerability scanning (F-32), AL2 past end of support (F-16), SSH-based access instead of SSM Session Manager.

data-classification.n: Demo data only; no classification scheme.

protect-data-rest.n: SSE-S3, SQS SSE, DynamoDB default encryption. P2 RDS unencrypted though free (F-14). Baseline P1 bucket public (F-04). Post: bucket private, OAC-only policy, Block Public Access on, IsPublic=False.

protect-data-transit.n: Baseline: viewer HTTPS but CloudFront->S3 http-only (F-05); P2 HTTP only (F-15). Post: S3 REST origin over HTTPS with SigV4 OAC + DenyInsecureTransport policy. Min TLS stays TLSv1 on default certificate (F-55, cost decision).

incident-response.n: No incident response plan or playbooks.

application-security.n: Terraform + GitHub Actions with pytest. Static AWS keys + SSH key design, no OIDC (F-23); unpinned third-party action, no permissions block (F-32, F-33).

sus_region.n: Regions chosen for cost/availability, not sustainability.

sus_user.n: Teardown after each demo (P4 leftover exception, F-36); SQS buffering in P4.

sus_software.n: Async processing via SQS; unused stacks removed after demos.

sus_data.n: Nothing backed up that Git/IaC can recreate. Baseline: SAM bucket kept 8 noncurrent versions with no lifecycle rule (F-52); orphaned log groups. Post: both removed.

sus_hardware.n: Smallest instance types; managed/serverless services (Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront). No Graviton (F-50).

sus_dev.n: IaC allows rapid improvement. Workload not kept up to date (F-16).

cost_q1.n: Defaults only: 128 MB, x86_64 (F-50), log retention never expire (F-40), Scan in /stats (F-48).

ops_q1.n: No alarms, tracing (PassThrough) or API access logs (F-39, F-47).

ops_q2.n: Terraform IaC (SAM retired); single stage, no separate environments or rollout mechanism.

perf_q1.n: Async processing via SQS event source mapping (batch 10).

rel_q1.n: HTTP API stage throttling 0/0, no quotas (F-43).

rel_q2.n: Retries + DLQ (maxReceiveCount 3). No ReportBatchItemFailures (F-45); visibility timeout = function timeout (F-44); DLQ retention = source (F-46).

sec_q1.n: All four routes authorization NONE; POST /ingest open to the internet (F-42).

sec_q2.n: Scoped Lambda permissions for API Gateway; execution-role temporary credentials. One shared role, logs on arn:aws:logs:*:*:* (F-38).

sec_q3.n: No dependency scanning or inbound event validation.
